scope: Disposable PGlite/PostGIS with simulated Auth sessions and Storage; no remote writes

results.name: full migration replay preserves drafts and assigns no administrator
anonymous RPC, draft and media access fail closed
ordinary users cannot self-promote, mutate content or inspect audit logs
admin role requires an active matching session and checks expiration
transactional draft save allowlists fields and rejects stale updates
incomplete publication is rejected via RPC and direct table write
image approval requires saved evidence and uploaded bytes
reviewed complete destination publishes and protects media dependencies
audit entries cannot be forged or edited by clients
browser input rejects unsafe data and executable image types
localized publication requires real current admin, exact saved versions and reviewed Arabic
a downstream translation failure rolls the publication transaction back
eligible English and Arabic become public together and retain actual actor evidence
